[1] By March 29, 1955, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA; [2] November 1, 1956, purchased by Allen-Bradley Co. (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [3] June 1969, gift to The Bradley Family Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); 1977, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] Downtown Gallery, O’Keeffe Exhibition: New Paintings (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1955), cat. 17. (as Black Door with Snow) 
[2] Invoice addressed to The Allen Bradley Company in MAM object file, with note that it was retained from on approval. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonne. Vol 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 809, cat. 1284. 
[3] Documentation from The Bradley Family Foundation in MAM object file. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonne. Vol 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 809, cat. 1284. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
